notes.title: Rebel Core: September Development Update
notes.content: [p]Boy does the time fly when you're [strike]having fun[/strike] working like crazy to make progress on a game in your part-time hours. Michael, Grant, and myself have been quiet, but hard at work pushing forward on a playable demo for Rebel Core: Awakens and it seemed like high time I made an update about it.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="xrhQ7-Q1E8w;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Pictures being worth a thousand words and all that, I thought the best lead-in would be a big ol video taking you all from main menu to level select, into the demo level (Wastelands - still very WIP!), and then into some smaller, more art-heavy test levels.[/p][p][/p][p]We've got all sorts of fun new stuff in this build, including basic enemy spawning systems, level selection and level loading with video intros, a basic pause menu, life pickups (health and extra lives!), a level checkpoint system, and a nearly complete-length test level (no boss fight in there yet though).[/p][p][/p][p]There's still a lot of work to go on enemy types and behaviors, and some more work to come on player movement, as well as combat improvements and...well...basically more to come on [i]everything[/i]...but that's early development for you.[/p][p][/p][p]-AtomDan[/p]

notes.title: Machinewaves #2 And More!
notes.content: [h2]Ambient Machinewaves 02: The Grid[/h2][previewyoutube="6amNoA04KH8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Ambient Machinewaves #2 brings a new song clip and takes us to the rainy outskirts of [b]The Grid[/b], a massive electrical complex that has become wildly unstable after years of overtaxed use by the Machines. [/p][p][/p][h2]Masters and Their Domains[/h2][p]Created by the mysterious Council, the Core Robotics are the pinnacle of robotic intelligence and capability, given full sapient thought and autonomous free-will* (some strings attached). Most were adapted from human-made designs during the machine uprising, though a few were made entirely by The Council. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691689/9d12bfb555f1d7dce1967a1a38cbdcc8df89a6a4.png"][/img][/p][p]Assigned to critical operations and serving as masters of the domains they have been entrusted with, each one must be defeated by the Rebel in order to gain access to The Council's domain within The Citadel. I look forward going into more detail on each of the Core Robotics, as well as the levels they call home in future posts![/p][p][/p][h2]Ouch, That Hurts![/h2][p]And last but not least, proper hit reactions and i-frames are now operational in the game! It may seem small, but a good, satisfying hit-react, the threat of knockback from it, and the brief moment of invincibility that brings repose after it are all critical elements of good platforming action.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691689/d6b62995c86d5d45fcd30e759ec4adb852828255.gif"][/img][/p]
